metrics.gate: sc_t3 equiv: mode none disagrees with the atlas on more than 1 of 8 episodes stops T3
metrics.labelled: development reads on N2 main states 4-23, which have shaped earlier work; changes no earlier verdict; the user approved the plan on 2026-11-05 and has not reviewed these rules
metrics.mapping_T0_A: per system and layout, first match: TOO FEW iff under 10 events in the fatal or control set; BOUNDARY iff CI lower bound of delta above 0 and delta > 0.10; else NOT AT BOUNDARIES
metrics.mapping_T0_B: per system: LONG iff long share >= 2/3 and CI lower >= 0.5; SHORT iff share <= 1/3 and CI upper <= 0.5; else MIXED
metrics.mapping_T3: first match: INSTRUMENT FAILS iff familiar hold in A or familiar success in B < 0.70; CONTACT FAILS iff either contrast's CI lies wholly below -0.10; CONTACT INVARIANT iff both CI lower bounds >= -0.10; else UNRESOLVED
metrics.prediction: T0 A NOT AT BOUNDARIES on both VLAs; T0 B MIXED on P_min, long share .4-.7; T3 CONTACT FAILS on A through near-fixture descents, D_B inside the margin, familiar rates over the floor
metrics.states: dev only: N2 main states 4-23; smoke states 0-1 read before this row
metrics.written_before: T0's read and any T3 run outside the smoke
